## 3. Provisioning Procedure
### Step 3.1: Sponsor Verification
Verify corporate identity against the approved client sponsor roster.
Requests from generic domains (gmail, yahoo) must be rejected immediately.

Page 3 of 4 — CONFIDENTIAL — ACME LOGISTICS INC.

### Step 3.2: Dual-Operator Sign-Off
Dual-operator authorization is strictly required:
1. Operator 1 initiates the credential generation request in the admin IAM portal.
2. Operator 2 (Senior Desk Lead) inspects the verification ticket and signs off with cryptographic OTP.

### Step 3.3: Sandbox Confinement

Vertex Health — Disaster Recovery Runbook 

Vertex Health Operations: Disaster Recovery & Failover Protocol 

 Document ID: SOP-DB-007 | Client: VERTEX-003 

1. Trigger Criteria 

Failover to secondary replica region (us-east-2) must initiate only when the primary cluster experiences unrecoverable latency exceeding 5000ms or 3 consecutive heartbeat timeouts. 

2. Execution Sequence 

Notify Incident Commander and open war-room bridge. 

Execute database promoter script: vertex-cli db failover --cluster prd-vtx-01 --force-replica . 

Update Route53 health check DNS pointers to secondary cluster target. 

Confirm integrity of encrypted patient data volumes before restoring application traffic. 

Compliance Notice: HIPAA / HITECH cryptographic validation required post-failover.
